profile.name: Aman Kumar Maurya
profile.photoTitle: Aman Kumar Maurya — AI & Space ML Engineer
profile.location: Sant Kabir Nagar / Gorakhpur, UP, India
profile.bio: Department 1st Rank Undergraduate in Computer Science, Statistics, and Mathematics with strong foundational engineering skills—building core ML, Deep Learning & Computer Vision systems from scratch alongside modern Agentic AI architectures. Selected presenter at ISRO – U.R. Rao Satellite Centre (URSC). Adept at architecting stateful Gemini + LangGraph agents, 100% offline neural voice assistants (JARVIS), autonomous n8n + SQL workflows, and ResNet50 / PoseNet CV pipelines.

moments.title: 1st Rank in Department — Academic Excellence Award
moments.date: Samman Samaroh • Target Gurukul & DDU GU
moments.description: Honoured with the 1st Rank Academic Excellence Trophy ("Where Success is a Tradition" — Samman Samaroh) for achieving 1st Rank in the Department in B.Sc. (Computer Science, Statistics & Mathematics) at Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Gorakhpur University.

moments.title: Research Presenter at ISRO – U.R. Rao Satellite Centre (URSC)
moments.description: Selected to present original research paper "AI and ML in Space" at ISRO-URSC, investigating deep learning architectures for high-throughput satellite data processing and autonomous space mission operations.

moments.title: Federated Space Intelligence (FSI) — Orbital AI Prototype & Poster
moments.description: Designed and showcased a decentralized orbital machine learning framework enabling collaborative model training across space missions while preserving data privacy and edge computing efficiency.

moments.title: Building Real-Time AR & Autonomous AI Systems
moments.description: From hand-coding real-time browser AR Iron Man suit overlays with PoseNet to engineering 100% offline neural desktop voice assistants (JARVIS) and LangGraph multi-turn agents.

projects.title: JARVIS ("Adventure") — Offline Neural Desktop Voice Assistant
projects.description: 100% offline, ultra-low-latency desktop voice automation OS powered by a local Kaldi/Vosk acoustic neural wake-word engine ("Adventure"), Per-Monitor DPI-aware Windows UI Automation for sub-pixel input field clicking, SAPI asynchronous TTS, hardware telemetry, and live console HUD.

projects.title: Autonomous Personal Task-Automation AI Agent
projects.description: Full-stack personal task-automation AI agent that takes high-level goals in natural language, plans multi-step execution graphs, and invokes extensible tools across Anthropic Claude & OpenAI models with PostgreSQL state, Redis queues, and Qdrant semantic vector memory.

projects.title: Stateful LangGraph + Google Gemini AI Chatbot
projects.description: ChatGPT-style multi-turn conversational agent built with LangGraph and Google Gemini API. Features conditional tool routing (DuckDuckGo web search + calculator), per-thread SQLite checkpoint persistence (SqliteSaver), and dual React (Vite) + Streamlit UIs.

projects.title: Autonomous Web-Search & Chat-with-Database Agent
projects.description: Engineered automated multi-step AI agent pipelines in n8n combining real-time web search retrieval with natural-language querying ("Chat with Data/Database") over structured SQL records for instant analytical insights.

projects.title: “Celebrity Look-Alike” Facial Recognition Engine
projects.description: Built an end-to-end facial similarity engine from scratch using a ResNet50 transfer-learning deep CNN backbone trained and evaluated on thousands of facial images across 100+ Bollywood celebrities with high-dimensional feature embedding extraction.

projects.title: Become Iron Man — Real-Time AR Full-Body Suit Overlay
projects.description: Hand-coded a browser-based real-time computer vision pipeline using p5.js and ml5.js (PoseNet) skeletal keypoint tracking to dynamically scale, rotate, and overlay a full virtual Iron Man suit onto live webcam video streams.

projects.title: Real-Time 17-Keypoint Human Pose & Skeletal Tracker
projects.description: Browser-native deep learning pose estimation engine capturing live webcam feeds to detect 17 human body keypoints (eyes, shoulders, elbows, wrists, hips, knees, ankles) and compute real-time inter-joint Euclidean kinematics.

projects.title: ISRO-URSC Research: “AI and ML in Space” & Orbital FSI
projects.description: Selected research presented at ISRO – U.R. Rao Satellite Centre (URSC) on deep learning for high-throughput satellite data processing and autonomous mission operations, paired with the Federated Space Intelligence (FSI) decentralized orbital learning prototype.

projects.title: TCS.NS Stock Price Forecasting (Box–Jenkins ARIMA)
projects.description: B.Sc. Statistics research applying classical Box–Jenkins ARIMA(1,1,1) modeling on 5 years of daily TCS.NS market prices. Includes ADF stationarity tests, ACF/PACF diagnostics, and automated research report generation, achieving 0.27% MAPE and 100% 95% CI coverage.

projects.title: AI-Powered Automated Video Generation Pipeline
projects.description: Python automation workflow integrating generative AI scripting, voice synthesis, and programmatic media assembly for end-to-end automated video creation.

projects.title: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Remote Server
projects.description: Remote server implementation for the Model Context Protocol (MCP) in Python, enabling LLM agents to securely discover and invoke external tools and data sources.

projects.title: Nidhi Medical Store — Cyber-Medical Portal & Admin Suite
projects.description: High-performance healthcare web portal featuring real-time store open/closed status calculation, WhatsApp prescription photo ordering, live medicine catalog search, clinical vitals showcase, Google Maps navigation, and PIN-protected Owner Admin Dashboard.

projects.title: Online Movie Ticket Booking System (Multi-Role)
projects.description: Full-stack role-based platform supporting ADMIN, THEATER Manager, and CUSTOMER workflows. Features theater approval, screen & show scheduling, interactive seat map selection (Regular, Premium, Gold), and an integrated digital wallet.

projects.title: Mastermind — Social-Impact Community App with AI ChatBox
projects.description: Hackathon social-impact web platform connecting volunteers with community opportunities and services, featuring an embedded conversational AI ChatBox powered by an n8n webhook workflow.

projects.title: Modern Footwear E-Commerce Storefront & Web Utilities
projects.description: Responsive React + Vite e-commerce storefront deployed on Vercel alongside interactive web applications including Magic Calculator and Spotify UI clones.
